def bubblesort(lst):
    n = len(lst)
    swapped = True
    while swapped:
        swapped = False
        for i in range(n - 1):
            if lst[i] > lst[i + 1]:
                # Swap the elements
                lst[i], lst[i + 1] = lst[i + 1], lst[i]
                swapped = True
        n -= 1
    return lst
